task: Pick up the banana from the table and place it on the saucer.

intervals.start: The gripper has not yet grabbed the banana, and its tip is about 5 cm away from the banana.
intervals.end: The gripper closes and has just fully gripped the banana, slightly lifting it up.

intervals.start: The gripper is holding the banana and about 10 cm away from the saucer.
intervals.end: The gripper releases the banana so that it now rests on the saucer.

intervals.label: The gripper grabs the banana from the table.
The gripper places the banana on the saucer.
